tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Christian Pure's library of more than 3,500 articles on prayer, Bible verses, Bible study, the meaning of names in the Bible, church history, marriage, parenting and questions of faith. Pass a few plain keywords, for example "anxiety", "Nathan name meaning" or "unforgivable sin". Returns up t

tools.name: find_prayers
tools.description: Find written prayers for a need or an occasion: illness, grief, a job interview, a court case, a marriage, a child, sleep, protection, thanksgiving. Returns Christian Pure prayer articles, each with an excerpt, summary points and a link to the full set of prayers.

tools.name: find_bible_verses
tools.description: Find Bible verses on a subject, such as anxiety, hope, forgiveness, marriage, strength or loss. Returns Christian Pure articles that gather and explain the verses on that subject, each with an excerpt, summary points and a link.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one Christian Pure article by its link or slug: title, excerpt, summary points, topics, image and dates. Use it when someone shares a christianpure.com link, or to look closer at a search result. Pass url or slug. The full text is on christianpure.com.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the subjects Christian Pure writes about, with the number of articles in each and a link to browse them. The slugs work as the topic filter in search_articles.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List Christian Pure's online courses, with a description, the number of lessons and a link to each course.

tools.name: get_newsletter
tools.description: Describe The Sunday Letter, Christian Pure's free weekly email, and give the link to sign up.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_article, get_newsletter · Public sink: get_newsletter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_article, get_newsletter · Public sink: get_newsletter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
